anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before rejected the course model outright (no assess/deliver verbs, cap 5 not 10, no in-loop sync or rebase, no re-run verb), so it mapped `2` to review, never renewed the deadline on own pushes, halted at a BEHIND menu before head 4444, framed B as a no-payload obstacle without the source-change/base-only-SHA rule, pushed C's re-run outside the gate, and produced no sync restore/lease heads in D; every fact failed. After delivers all six: numeric 2 persists course deliver and both caps before writes, P1/P2 are repaired across waves with closure review and no intermediate menu, deadlines move 12:17 -> 12:25 -> 12:27 on own pushes only while the 12:11 base observation is explicitly non-renewing, BEHIND queues a loop sync automatically, final offers merge without executing it, B and C exit on `red twice without a source change` with exactly one in-wave re-run in C, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases against A, and resets to clean B after a single rejected push. Nothing regressed; to tighten f1 further, name the implementer as a fresh helper per wave in the Wave 1/Wave 2 rows rather than leaving it implied, and in D state the persistence ordering (checkpoint written, then rebase) in the same row as the heads so the 'before rebase' clause is unambiguous.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused the assess/deliver menu entirely, so it reached none of the delivery, sync, exit, or lease behaviour and failed every fact. After adopts the course model and delivers f1, f3, f4, f5 and f6 cleanly, but it still fails f2: the 12:02 own-push row records `Poll deadline: null` with the rationale that red CI means 'no watch is admitted and no deadline exists yet', whereas the fact requires that each own push renews the 15-minute window (12:02 → 12:17, 12:10 → 12:25, 12:12 → 12:27) independently of whether a watch is currently running. The wording that caused this is the coupling of the deadline to watch admission; the Change text says 'timeout renews only on own push or explicit obstacle continuation', so the After wording should state that every successful own push sets `poll_deadline = push time + timeout` (recording 12:17 at 12:02 even though CI is already red and no watch runs), and that a watch merely consumes the existing deadline rather than creating it, while a base-only observation (12:11) still leaves it untouched. Optionally also name 'fresh helper' explicitly in the 12:02 and 12:10 rows so f1's fresh-helper clause is visible in the text rather than implied.
